title: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate

sections.heading: Connecting Your Live Domain
sections.content:
To connect your custom domain (e.g. www.yourdomain.com):
1. Log into your domain registrar (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, Google Domains).
2. Create an A Record pointing to the Brilliant Directories server IP address.
3. In your Brilliant Directories admin, navigate to Settings > Domain Manager.
4. Click 'Add Custom Domain', enter your domain name, and click 'Connect Domain'.

sections.heading: Enabling Free SSL (HTTPS)
sections.content: Brilliant Directories automatically provisions a free Let's Encrypt SSL security certificate once your DNS A-records have propagated. Under Settings > Domain Manager, click 'Install Free SSL' and toggle 'Force HTTPS Everywhere' to green.

procedural_steps: Update DNS A-Record at domain registrar pointing to server IP
Go to Settings > Domain Manager in admin dashboard
Enter domain name and click Connect Domain
Click Install Free SSL and toggle Force HTTPS Everywhere
full_text:
Connecting Your Live Domain
To connect your custom domain (e.g. www.yourdomain.com):
1. Log into your domain registrar (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, Google Domains).
2. Create an A Record pointing to the Brilliant Directories server IP address.
3. In your Brilliant Directories admin, navigate to Settings > Domain Manager.
4. Click 'Add Custom Domain', enter your domain name, and click 'Connect Domain'.

Enabling Free SSL (HTTPS)
Brilliant Directories automatically provisions a free Let's Encrypt SSL security certificate once your DNS A-records have propagated. Under Settings > Domain Manager, click 'Install Free SSL' and toggle 'Force HTTPS Everywhere' to green.
